name: High-stress LPCVD SiN

sources.citation: Land et al., Sub-ppm Nanomechanical Absorption Spectroscopy of Silicon Nitride
sources.kind: Eight minimum extinction coefficients stated explicitly in the author preprint text, in ppm, converted to dimensionless k.
sources.specimen: High-tensile-stress stoichiometric LPCVD Si3N4 trampolines; stress 0.85 GPa in the model.
sources.caveat: Several devices/wafers were studied; the 1550 nm point is from a second device type. Post-deposition annealing history is not specified.

sources.kind: Measured LPCVD thermo-optic coefficient, Eq. (3), averaged over 1460-1550 nm
sources.sample_match: Stress and annealing state unspecified; transferred to the selected SiN formulation as an explicit approximation.
sources.construction: Integrate dn/dT from 300 K and add the selected material room-temperature n at 1550 nm. These are sampled fit values, not measured n(T) for this specimen.

borrowed_references.reason: LPCVD film with unspecified stress/annealing state.

notes: Only eight room-temperature k points and one room-temperature n point are present; missing wavelengths require an explicitly configured, documented fallback.
Target category is high-stress nonannealed SiN, but the Land source does not establish its annealing history.
No measured k(T) is bundled. Do not extend this sparse near-IR k spectrum into the thermal infrared.
schema: temperature_k,wavelength_um,n,k; empty n or k means unknown
fallback_policy: The suggested file is used only when explicitly named by data.fallback_file in a configuration.
